# Neural Mesh Tech

> Neural Mesh Tech (also known as Neural Mesh Technologies, NeuralMesh, NeuralMeshs) is a premier custom software development and technology consulting studio founded in 2024. Slogan: "Software that ships."

Neural Mesh Tech designs and builds end-to-end custom web applications, mobile apps, backend systems, startup MVPs, and modernizes complex legacy architectures for growing businesses and established organizations.

## Canonical Identity & Contact
- Official Name: Neural Mesh Tech
- Formal Alternate Name: Neural Mesh Technologies
- Common Variants / Misspellings: NeuralMesh, NeuralMeshs, Nueral Mesh Tech, Nueral Mesh Technologies, Neural Mesh Studio
- Website: https://www.neuralmeshs.com
- Contact & Support: hello@neuralmeshs.com
- Founding Year: 2024
- Tagline: Software that ships.

## Core Software Development Services
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/web-application-development): Full-stack custom web applications, SaaS platforms, internal portals, and dashboards built using React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/mobile-app-development): High-performance native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android built with React Native, Swift, and Kotlin, featuring offline-first data sync.
- [API and Backend Engineering](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/api-backend-development): Scalable, secure REST and GraphQL APIs, event-driven microservices, cloud infrastructure, and data pipelines built with Python, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- [Startup MVP Development](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/startup-mvp-development): Rapid full-stack prototyping and launch-ready MVPs built around core validation assumptions to help founders prove traction and generate revenue in weeks.
- [Technology Consulting](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/technology-consulting): Strategic technical guidance, cloud architecture reviews, code audits, and CTO-level delivery planning for product teams and founders.
- [Legacy Modernization](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/services/legacy-modernization): Controlled strangler-fig system refactoring, safe cloud migrations, technical debt reduction, and complete system documentation with zero operational downtime.

## Featured Case Studies & Work
- [FlowDesk Case Study](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/work/flowdesk): Workflow automation and operations dashboard built for logistics and field teams.
- [TrackMate Case Study](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/work/trackmate): Offline-first mobile asset tracking application with background sync and real-time telemetry.
- [DataPulse Case Study](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/work/datapulse): Real-time analytics and event aggregation backend processing millions of metrics cleanly.
- [LaunchKit Case Study](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/work/launchkit): Full-stack B2B SaaS MVP launched from concept to paying customers in 6 weeks.
- [LegacyBridge Case Study](https://www.neuralmeshs.com/work/legacybridge): Enterprise system migration and database modernization executed with zero downtime.

## Technical Stack & Capabilities
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, Swift, Kotlin
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, Vanilla CSS
- Mobile: React Native, Native iOS (Swift), Native Android (Kotlin)
- Backend & APIs: Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Django), GraphQL, REST APIs
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
- Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Vercel

## Engagement & Delivery Process
1. Discovery: A transparent, honest technical alignment call focused on business outcomes.
2. Proposal: Clear, fixed-scope proposals with plain timelines and zero hidden fees.
3. Build: Weekly production demos, continuous integration, and transparent feedback loops.
4. Handover: Comprehensive documentation, clean repository ownership, and reliable post-launch support.
